priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Canonical preimages were self-referential or incomplete
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Defined domain-separated RFC 8785 preimages, exact exclusions, array ordering, lowercase SHA-256, UTF-8 and UTC timestamp rules for all named hashes.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Signature algorithm, key and producer trust policy were incomplete
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Added four purpose-specific signer contracts and fail-closed algorithm policy, trust registry, identity mapping, validity, rotation, revocation and compromise inputs.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Verdict uniqueness and read identity were ambiguous
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Submission ID now derives from trusted producer identity plus validationRunId; unique run replay/conflict/supersession and exact-submission verdict read are explicit.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Evidence transfer allowed undefined URI references
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Replaced with allow-listed exact Azure Blob version pull, conditional metadata/hash/scan verification, assurance WORM copy, private RBAC/DNS and SSRF/version-swap negatives.
Added Internal Audit policy, benchmark/test registries, evaluator release/images, schemas, limits and approval bindings; verdict binds all.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Internal Audit-owned assurance implementation package was missing
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Phase 4 adds WP-05 with Internal Audit repository/build/sign/release/ACR/deployment/operations authority; DU-16 admits signed digests only.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Submitted artifacts and evaluator isolation were under-specified
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Defined untrusted-input handling, static default, separately authorised ephemeral least-privilege sandbox and fail-closed limits.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Analysis configuration/input canonical bindings and hostile-content policies were incomplete
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Added canonical hashes plus chunking, instruction/data separation, injection corpus/control, Search schema/alias and revocation bindings.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Vector provenance and tenant/case isolation fields were incomplete
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Added tenant/case, both manifest hashes, chunk/evidence hashes, policies, embedding/schema fields, deterministic scoped keys and server-injected filters.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Prompt-injection, cross-boundary retrieval and poisoned-index recovery tests were missing
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Added hostile tests, revocation invalidation, known-good versioned rebuild and validated atomic alias switch; tools/fallback prohibited.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Audit producer authenticity and receipt binding were incomplete
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Required producer-signed events; receipt binds verified producer/key, event/body hashes, stream position and assurance signer and limits meaning to integrity receipt.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Audit stream uniqueness and continuity conflict rules were incomplete
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Enforced unique tenant/case/sequence, strict sender order, tenant:case sessions, predecessor validation and no continuity advance for gaps/conflicts/signature/schema/poison.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Local receipt success could be fabricated
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Added final body hash, role-separated receipt trust/signature verification and exact-binding guard before VERIFIED_CONTIGUOUS.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Audit size, duplicate-window, expiry and ordering relationships were absent
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Added fail-closed parameters/assertions including TTL greater than grace plus retry/reconciliation; rollback preserves all evidence.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Phase 4 work, mappings, parameters and counts were not fully reconciled
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Phase 4 catalogue is regenerated across DUs, packages, WP-05, validation, sequence, identities, mappings, owner evidence, controls and coverage.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: DAG rationale and activation sequence were incomplete
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Retained 17 DUs/46 edges after acyclic verification; DU-16 depends on DU-09 for source evidence path and exact software→infrastructure→private path→copy tests→clients sequence is defined.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Three-boundary authority flow overlay was missing
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Added editable draw.io and sanitised accessible SVG for pull/copy, verdict, governed analysis/vectorisation and audit push/receipt.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Amendment HTML did not meet required Clawpilot rendering contract
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: Regenerated self-contained HTML with theme detector first, exact variables, var-only component colours, required fonts and Markdown parity.

priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.preliminaryFinding: Change control did not enumerate preliminary findings/remediation
priorPreliminaryFindingDispositions.candidateRemediation: This evidence records all 19 findings, exact remediation, status, selections, baseline/supersession, author/revision and required formal re-review.

reviewAreaResults.evidence: Domain-separated RFC8785 rules define exact exclusions; manifests do not self-list; hash-generation evidence records self-reference exclusion.
Four signer purposes, trust registries, key versions, validity/revocation/compromise and wrong-purpose denial are present.
submissionId derives from trusted producer identity plus validationRunId; replay/conflict/correction and exact verdict endpoint are specified.
Approved account/container/blob/version/ETag/hash/type/size/role plus private RBAC/DNS and WORM copy are required; SAS/URL/public/redirect are denied.
Internal Audit-owned policy, registries, test suite, release/image digests, schemas and limits bind verdicts.

reviewAreaResults.area: Internal Audit-owned assurance software/release package and authority
reviewAreaResults.evidence: WP-05 and DU-16 define ownership and signed release gates; package creation remains future owner-bound work.
Static default and separately authorised ephemeral no-management/no-secret/no-public-egress sandbox are specified fail-closed.
configurationBindingHash and inputManifestHash bind adapter, prompt, model, embedding, safety, chunking, filters and revocation evidence.
Vector records and keys include tenant/case, manifest hashes, chunk/evidence provenance, dimensions and schema.
Hostile-content, cross-boundary, citation, index poison and revocation tests plus known-good alias recovery are specified.
Audit events require producer token/signature/trust verification and final signed body hashing.
Unique tenant/case/sequence, SessionId tenantId:caseId, predecessor validation and no continuity advance for gaps/conflicts/poison are specified.
Receipt binds identity/key/event/body/stream/signer and role-separated reconciler verifies before VERIFIED_CONTIGUOUS/material transition.
Message size, duplicate window, max delivery, dead-letter-on-expiry, TTL/retry relationship and one-dispatcher ordering are assertions/parameters.
17 DUs, five WPs, 170 parameters, 60 assertions, 12 controls, 10 identities and 19 validation entries reconcile; owner inputs remain fail-closed.
17-node/46-edge graph is acyclic; DU-09→DU-16 rationale and six-step activation are stated.
Accessible draw.io/SVG authority overlay is bound and sanitised with title/description and no script/foreignObject/external references.
Phase amendment HTML files are self-contained, parseable, Clawpilot-themed with theme detector first and no external runtime dependencies.
Change evidence enumerates all 19 preliminary findings, dispositions, baselines, superseded preliminary copies and review/approval boundaries.
